# Jelly Gates: Block Jam Puzzle

> Jelly Gates: Block Jam Puzzle (short name: Jelly Gates) is a candy-themed sliding-block puzzle game by Wakeup Monster for Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store). Players slide coloured jellies out through the gate with the same colour and symbol, earn stars to build a jelly town, and play daily challenges. No login or cloud save: players are guests and progress is stored on the device. Monetisation: optional rewarded/interstitial ads (Google AdMob) and in-app purchases. Not directed at children under 13.

Key facts:
- Developer: Wakeup Monster
- Genre: sliding-block puzzle (casual)
- Platforms: Android, iOS (launching; store links on the home page when live)
- Accounts: none (guest play)
- Purchases: Google Play Billing / Apple StoreKit, verified by our Firebase Cloud Functions backend with a purchase token and product id only
